svg.data-power-without-poe: 27.1 W at 110 V, 27.5 W at 220 V (system power consumption, worst case)
svg.data-power-with-poe: 233.2 W at 110 V, 230.5 W at 220 V (worst case)
svg.data-poe-standard: IEEE 802.3at PoE+, 802.3af, and Cisco pre-standard (legacy) PoE; 30 W per port
svg.data-operating-temp: -5 to 50 C (23 to 122 F); cold start from 0 C (32 F)
svg.data-optics-sfp: The ordering table calls the four uplinks "4x Gigabit SFP" (p36). The data sheet's supported-optics table (p27-29) is not keyed by model; its 1000 Mbps SFPs are MGBSX1, MGBLX1, MGBLH1, MGBT1, GLC-SX-MMD, GLC-EX-SMD, GLC-ZX-SMD, GLC-LH-SMD, GLC-BX-U, GLC-BX-D, GLC-TE and the CWDM-SFP-1470 to -1610 series.
svg.data-reset: recessed button on the front panel
svg.data-certifications: UL (UL 62368), CSA (CSA 22.2), CE mark, FCC Part 15 (CFR 47) Class A
